title: LADA Doofers vs Sentinels, Sep 19
notes: LADA Doofers' first processed game. Home at Snoqualmie B: we wore white and had the left bench. The video is the camera's whole fisheye frame, but YouTube only has it at 1440p (scaled up for detection). LADA's schedule didn't list the game; its id came from the games against the Sentinels.
The game sheet (SportNinja, read through its public API) gave the score, the scorers, the penalties, the shots and who played; each goal was found on the video and against the arena scoreboard.

Periods from the board's clock (the empty-ice proposal merged the 1st and 2nd): the 1st ended at 18:43 of video and the board then counted a 1:00 intermission; after the 2nd it counted a 2:00 one. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd and stopped at whistles in the 3rd.

Wheeler #0 in goal for the shutout (#1 Mayorov and #20 Starodubtsev absent). Ten skaters, five of them subs: Skitsko #16, Babkin #26, Tverskoy #44, Prozhogin #61, Kleiman #69. Absent: #4, #6, #11, #12, #13, #25, #27, #38, #52, #54, #71, #75, #76, #98. LADA's lines had Panov #76, but every read of 76 was Skitsko's 16.
Sourov #31 arrived late: he walked into the bench about 14 minutes into the 1st and first stepped on near the end of the period.

Penalties: Sourov's tripping with 1:06 left in the 2nd (coincidental with Sentinels #17) wasn't served in the 2nd, where we played 5 on 4 to the end; he sat the first 2:00 of the 3rd, 4-on-4. Albantov's interference at 2:43 of the 3rd, 2 minutes. The last one (tripping at 0:30 of the 3rd) is Sourov's on the game sheet, but Akulov #37 went to the box, as the board showed.
Shots from the board, matching the game sheet.

Labeled by hand: two review rows that read 19 off a sleeve (no one wears 19; one was Kleiman) set to unknown, and on/off corrections from a frame-by-frame check of every lineup gap: #16 and #69 swapped early in the 1st, a referee counted as #97 in the 2nd, players missed at goals 1, 2, 4, 6 and 7, and several line changes.

Republished Oct 22, 2026 after a pipeline fix: a review row the reviewer called noise (an opponent or a referee, nobody of ours) now loses its OCR label instead of keeping it weakly. Ice time moved by #97 -45 s, #31 +21 s, #69 +18 s, #26 +6 s, #46 -4 s, #16 +2 s, #37 +2 s, #44 -2 s.

highlights.note: 1st period, clock 12:45: a scramble in their crease, Kleiman #69 from Akulov, 1-0
1st period, clock 1:11: Babkin feeds from the left and Akulov #37 finishes at the back door with the goalie down, 2-0
2nd period, clock 11:50: a scramble with the goalie down, Zakharankau #97 from Albantov, 3-0
3rd period, clock 17:08: a crash on the net 4-on-4, Tverskoy #44 from Babkin and Akulov, 4-0
3rd period, clock 5:45 (the board stopped at 5:37): power play, Zakharankau #97 drives the right side and scores with the goalie sprawled, 6-0
3rd period, clock 4:31: a scramble with the goalie down, Tverskoy #44 from Babkin, 7-0
3rd period, clock 3:53: Akulov #37 carries in alone and jams it in at the post, 8-0
2nd period, clock 1:06: tripping, coincidental with Sentinels #17's slashing; Sourov sat out the first 3 minutes of the 3rd (2:00 of clock), 4-on-4
3rd period, clock 2:43: interference away from the puck near the left circle, 2 minutes
